prompt_text: What is the best home care agency in Pleasanton CA for an elderly parent?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agency—the right choice depends on your parent’s needs, schedule, and budget. **I’d start by interviewing Senior Helpers Pleasanton and Right at Home Pleasanton**, then compare them with **Home Instead**, which serves Pleasanton from its Union City office.

- **Senior Helpers Pleasanton** — local office; its listing gives California home-care license **414700072**. [Website](https://www.seniorhelpers.com/ca/pleasanton/)
- **Right at Home Pleasanton** — offers help with daily activities, mobility, transportation, and some condition-specific care. [Agency listing](https://www.caring.com/senior-care/in-home-care/california/pleasanton)
- **Home Instead** — serves Pleasanton and advertises dementia and 24-hour care; its local page reports a 4.8 Google rating from 37 reviews. [Pleasanton service page](https://www.homeinstead.com/home-care/usa/ca/fremont/291/service-area/home-care-in-pleasanton-ca/)

Before choosing, ask each agency to confirm current California licensing and insurance, caregiver screening and training, backup coverage, minimum hours, total hourly and overnight rates, and how they handle a poor caregiver match. Ask for references from families with similar care needs, and arrange an in-home assessment before committing. If your parent needs **skilled nursing or medical treatment**, clarify that explicitly: many home-care agencies primarily provide non-medical assistance.

If you share the kind of help needed (for example, dementia care, bathing, overnight supervision, or a few hours of companionship) and your approximate budget, I can help narrow the options.
